title: Coefficient comparison square with a prescribed composite
statement: Let c compactify a separated finite-type map f:X -> Y [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let A,B,C be finite commutative rings, phi:A -> B, psi:B -> C and chi:A -> C with psi phi=chi. Let ell be a prime which is a unit in every stalk on Y. For arbitrary unbounded H in D(X_proet,C), the published compact-support restriction composition square [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars] holds with the prescribed map chi and with its equality cast inserted in both derived restriction composition comparisons. This asserts the coefficient comparison square, not a cocycle for any additional arrows.

theorem compactSupportRestriction_comp_cast (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {A B C : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Finite A] [Finite B] [Finite C]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hl : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    (c : Compactification f) (φ : A →+* B) (ψ : B →+* C)
    (χ : A →+* C) (hχ : ψ.comp φ = χ) (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X C) :
    (sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate A c).map
        ((compactSupportCoefficientResComp X φ ψ χ hχ).hom.app K) ≫
          (compactSupportCoefficientComparison c χ).hom.app K =
      (compactSupportCoefficientComparison c φ).hom.app
          ((compactSupportCoefficientRestriction X ψ).obj K) ≫
        (compactSupportCoefficientRestriction Y φ).map
          ((compactSupportCoefficientComparison c ψ).hom.app K) ≫
        (compactSupportCoefficientResComp Y φ ψ χ hχ).hom.app
          ((sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate C c).obj K)
